```{r}
# Memuat library TSA untuk plot EACF
library(TSA)

# Menentukan seed agar hasil pembangkitan data konsisten/reproducible
set.seed(123)
```

# **PROSES MA(2)**
```{r}
# --- 1. Pembangkitan Data MA(2) (n = 300) ---
# Parameter MA(2): theta1 = 0.4, theta2 = 0.6
n <- 300
e <- rnorm(n + 2, mean = 0, sd = 1) # White noise

# a. Pembangkitan Manual
ma2_manual <- numeric(n)
for (t in 1:n) {
  ma2_manual[t] <- e[t+2] + 0.4 * e[t+1] + 0.6 * e[t]
}

# b. Pembangkitan dengan arima.sim
ma2_sim <- arima.sim(model = list(ma = c(0.4, 0.6)), n = n)

# --- 2. Plot Identifikasi & Stasioneritas ---
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(ma2_manual, type = "l", main = "Plot Time Series MA(2)", ylab = "Yt")
acf(ma2_manual, main = "Plot ACF MA(2)")
pacf(ma2_manual, main = "Plot PACF MA(2)")
eacf(ma2_manual) 
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# --- 3. Scatterplot (Yt vs Lag) ---
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(ma2_manual[2:n], ma2_manual[1:(n-1)], xlab = "Yt-1", ylab = "Yt", main = "Yt vs Yt-1")
plot(ma2_manual[3:n], ma2_manual[1:(n-2)], xlab = "Yt-2", ylab = "Yt", main = "Yt vs Yt-2")
plot(ma2_manual[4:n], ma2_manual[1:(n-3)], xlab = "Yt-3", ylab = "Yt", main = "Yt vs Yt-3")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# --- 4. Hitung Autokorelasi (Sampel vs Teoritis) ---
# Autokorelasi Sampel (Data Bangkitan)
acf_ma2_sample <- acf(ma2_manual, lag.max = 3, plot = FALSE)$acf[1:4]

# Autokorelasi Teoritis
acf_ma2_theoretical <- ARMAacf(ma = c(0.4, 0.6), lag.max = 3)

# Perbandingan Hasil
data.frame(
  Lag = 0:3,
  Teoritis = acf_ma2_theoretical,
  Sampel = acf_ma2_sample
)
```

# **PROSES AR(2)**
```{r}
# --- 1. Pembangkitan Data AR(2) (n = 300) ---
# Parameter AR(2): phi1 = 0.5, phi2 = 0.2
e_ar <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)

# a. Pembangkitan Manual
ar2_manual <- numeric(n)
ar2_manual[1] <- e_ar[1]
ar2_manual[2] <- 0.5 * ar2_manual[1] + e_ar[2]

for (t in 3:n) {
  ar2_manual[t] <- 0.5 * ar2_manual[t-1] + 0.2 * ar2_manual[t-2] + e_ar[t]
}

# b. Pembangkitan dengan arima.sim
ar2_sim <- arima.sim(model = list(ar = c(0.5, 0.2)), n = n)

# --- 2. Plot Identifikasi & Stasioneritas ---
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(ar2_manual, type = "l", main = "Plot Time Series AR(2)", ylab = "Yt")
acf(ar2_manual, main = "Plot ACF AR(2)")
pacf(ar2_manual, main = "Plot PACF AR(2)")
eacf(ar2_manual)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# --- 3. Scatterplot (Yt vs Lag) ---
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(ar2_manual[2:n], ar2_manual[1:(n-1)], xlab = "Yt-1", ylab = "Yt", main = "Yt vs Yt-1")
plot(ar2_manual[3:n], ar2_manual[1:(n-2)], xlab = "Yt-2", ylab = "Yt", main = "Yt vs Yt-2")
plot(ar2_manual[4:n], ar2_manual[1:(n-3)], xlab = "Yt-3", ylab = "Yt", main = "Yt vs Yt-3")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# --- 4. Hitung Autokorelasi (Sampel vs Teoritis) ---
acf_ar2_sample <- acf(ar2_manual, lag.max = 3, plot = FALSE)$acf[1:4]
acf_ar2_theoretical <- ARMAacf(ar = c(0.5, 0.2), lag.max = 3)

data.frame(
  Lag = 0:3,
  Teoritis = acf_ar2_theoretical,
  Sampel = acf_ar2_sample
)
```

# **PROSES ARMA(2,2)**
```{r}
# --- 1. Pembangkitan Data ARMA(2,2) (n = 300) ---
# Parameter ARMA(2,2): phi1=0.5, phi2=0.2, theta1=0.4, theta2=0.6
e_arma <- rnorm(n + 2, mean = 0, sd = 1)

# a. Pembangkitan Manual
arma22_manual <- numeric(n)
# Inisialisasi lag awal
arma22_manual[1] <- e_arma[3] + 0.4 * e_arma[2] + 0.6 * e_arma[1]
arma22_manual[2] <- 0.5 * arma22_manual[1] + e_arma[4] + 0.4 * e_arma[3] + 0.6 * e_arma[2]

for (t in 3:n) {
  arma22_manual[t] <- 0.5 * arma22_manual[t-1] + 0.2 * arma22_manual[t-2] + 
                      e_arma[t+2] + 0.4 * e_arma[t+1] + 0.6 * e_arma[t]
}

# b. Pembangkitan dengan arima.sim
arma22_sim <- arima.sim(model = list(ar = c(0.5, 0.2), ma = c(0.4, 0.6)), n = n)

# --- 2. Plot Identifikasi & Stasioneritas ---
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(arma22_manual, type = "l", main = "Plot Time Series ARMA(2,2)", ylab = "Yt")
acf(arma22_manual, main = "Plot ACF ARMA(2,2)")
pacf(arma22_manual, main = "Plot PACF ARMA(2,2)")
eacf(arma22_manual)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# --- 3. Scatterplot (Yt vs Lag) ---
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(arma22_manual[2:n], arma22_manual[1:(n-1)], xlab = "Yt-1", ylab = "Yt", main = "Yt vs Yt-1")
plot(arma22_manual[3:n], arma22_manual[1:(n-2)], xlab = "Yt-2", ylab = "Yt", main = "Yt vs Yt-2")
plot(arma22_manual[4:n], arma22_manual[1:(n-3)], xlab = "Yt-3", ylab = "Yt", main = "Yt vs Yt-3")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# --- 4. Hitung Autokorelasi (Sampel vs Teoritis) ---
acf_arma22_sample <- acf(arma22_manual, lag.max = 3, plot = FALSE)$acf[1:4]
acf_arma22_theoretical <- ARMAacf(ar = c(0.5, 0.2), ma = c(0.4, 0.6), lag.max = 3)

data.frame(
  Lag = 0:3,
  Teoritis = acf_arma22_theoretical,
  Sampel = acf_arma22_sample
)
```
